summary.en: During the night of the Tenkaichi Festival at the Okeyama Hotel, an author named Satoru Imatake is brushing his teeth in the bathroom, and his friend, Norikazu Sasai is making a mess. When he checks on Sasai, he is confused about Sasai being dressed up weird, and sees that the hotel room was a big mess. Sasai raises his gun to aim at Imatake's forehead and shoots him. He also takes his money from his wallet. Location: Okeyama Hotel room Victim: Satoru Imatake Cause of death: Gunshot wound Culprit: Norikazu Sasai The award-winning author, Satoru Imatake, was killed in his hotel room on the night of the Tenkaichi Festival. A man was seen fleeing the scene of shooting. He leaves the hotel room and flees out of the hotel. He throws away his gun, coat, and his glasses, and keeps his disposable camera. While at the Tenkaichi Festival, Ran, Conan, and Kogoro are having a good time. Sasai just finally arrives at the festival while sweating. He finds Ran and asks her to take a picture of him behind the background of the mountain on which the character "Ichi" is written. Sasai gives the camera to Ran and she takes a picture. He tells Ran that he's collecting an archive based on the theme "Local Festivals", which includes the photo that Ran took. Ran realizes that he's an author. Sasai also tells her that he used to write under the pen name "Tomokazu Imai", and Ran is excited, since she read his books while in junior high. Kogoro thinks it's strange and mentions that that name was used by Satoru Imatake when he made his debut. Sasai tells them that he's a friend of Imatake, and plans to drink in celebration for Imatake's Naomoto award. Sasai starts sweating more because he's wearing a jacket. After the conversation, Sasai asks Ran if she could take more pictures of him around the festival and Ran doesn't mind at all. While she's taking pictures of Sasai, a man appears behind him. The man's name is Yokomizo, a policeman. Yokomizo reveals Imatake has been murdered in the hotel room where he and Sasai are staying, and takes Sasai in for questioning. Conan, Ran and Kogoro follow them.
